name: Darcy Richardson
title: Registered Psychologist
description: Darcy works primarily with adults and is experienced in working with identity struggles, impacts from trauma (including PTSD, complex PTSD), anxiety, and eating differences/struggles as well as diagnosed eating disorders. Darcy utilises a Health at Every Size lens (HAES), Neurodivergent-affirming framework, and prioritises working with our LGBTQIA+SB community (as a proud member herself). Also skilled at working with disabled communities, including Autistic folk and ADHDers.
specialties: LGBTQIA+SB, trauma, PTSD, complex PTSD, eating disorders, HAES, neurodivergent-affirming
identity: 'a proud member' of the LGBTQIA+SB community

name: Cristian Mcheileh
title: Psychologist, Founder
description: Cristian aims to create a safe space to process and explore trauma, spiritual crisis, and psychosis. He also has an interest in working with people across diverse sexuality, sex, and gender spectrums. The practice provides care to people whose identities include diverse sexual orientation, open relationships and polyamory. Clinics in Heidelberg (3/95 Darebin Street) and Richmond (488 Victoria Street).
specialties: trauma, sexuality and gender diversity, open relationships/polyamory, psychosis, spiritual crisis

name: Melissa Bell
title: Principal Psychologist
description: Her work covers concerns such as anxiety, depression, stress, trauma, grief, relationships, workplace issues and life changes. Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing (EMDR) is an approach used in trauma-focused therapy; Melissa is EMDR trained. Face-to-face appointments in South Yarra along with telehealth sessions for adults 18+.
specialties: trauma, EMDR, anxiety, BPD, adult ADHD assessment

name: Holly Monaghan
title: Principal Psychologist
description: My approach is non-judgemental, trauma-informed and neuroaffirming. Evidence-based treatment approaches I use include: EMDR, Schema Therapy, CBT & ACT. Areas include Trauma (Single Incident and Complex Trauma) and workplace issues including Workcover. In person at Thornbury or Montmorency, or telehealth Australia-wide.
specialties: EMDR, schema therapy, complex trauma, neuroaffirming, WorkCover
